headline: Agility Robotics says a fast-charging battery from UK firm Nyobolt will let its Digit 5 humanoid robot work more than 20 hours a day.
score_reason: Relevant to the humanoid business case but company claims with delivery not before 2027.
importance_line: Warehouse and factory customers could get more work from each robot, but the 20-hour figure is the companies' claim and the robot is not due for early access until the first half of 2027.
summary: The Robot Report reports that Agility Robotics, maker of the Digit humanoid warehouse robot, said on 15 Oct 2026 that UK firm Nyobolt will supply a battery for Digit 5 that runs 90 minutes and recharges in nine minutes, which the companies claim allows more than 20 hours of work a day. Early access is planned for the first half of 2027.
notes: Product announcement; claims are the companies'.
